claims.assertion: Athena and Yazhi describe densities as mental or perceptual states, not places; a visitor carries their prior mindset to Venus.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena); Yazhi

claims.assertion: Anéeka says a 3D mindset may perceive only part of Venus, while perception ranges are unstable and differ even among civilizations classed as 5D.
claims.speaker: Anéeka; Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena says military APCs transit portals to Venus; a well-built portal can make passage immediate, while moving greater mass requires more energy.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
